{{ // head-extra — the hook a layered theme uses to add its own content. // // juicerdocs calls this from `head.html`, immediately after its own // stylesheet and before `customCSS`, so a theme inheriting juicerdocs can // add a stylesheet, a font or a meta tag without shipping a copy of the // whole hundred-line head partial — which is the thing that makes two // layered themes drift apart. // // This default is deliberately empty. Override it by shipping // `partials/head-extra.html` in the inheriting theme, or in the site's own // `partials/`, which wins over both. // // Precedence: site files > inheriting theme > juicerdocs > juicercommon. }}
